subject.title: fix(macos): Settings remote test hides gateway auth recovery steps

question: Should this visible macOS Settings auth-recovery change require redacted real UI proof before merge, or will maintainers accept an explicit proof override?
rationale: The source path and focused tests support the implementation, but the contributor explicitly reports no real macOS Settings UI proof for the visible prompt.

options.title: Require redacted Settings proof
options.body: Ask for a screenshot or short recording showing Settings Test remote rendering the structured auth recovery prompt after an auth failure, with private details redacted.

options.title: Accept proof override
options.body: A maintainer may explicitly override the real-behavior proof gate if they have separately verified the macOS Settings UI path.

recommendation.title: Require redacted Settings proof
recommendation.body: Ask for a screenshot or short recording showing Settings Test remote rendering the structured auth recovery prompt after an auth failure, with private details redacted.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged macOS Settings, onboarding, and remote-gateway work makes this the best available proof-sufficiency owner for the affected surface.
